note: Hazen Parks & Recreation RV park on the west side of Hazen, an older park with mature trees beside Christann Park's playground; the comfort station has a kitchenette. Half the sites are let long-term. --Claude
summary: City pages + WebReserv: $25 every night ($150/week), 28 full-hookup 50-amp pull-throughs (14 short-term 1-30 nights + 14 long-term), early May-Sep 30, WebReserv booking. Workforce check: no crew/workforce wording; half the sites are long-term (monthly billing) but the 14 short-term ones are sold by the night. Pin ok.
flags: WORKFORCE / LONG-STAY: no workforce, crew or contractor wording on the city page or WebReserv. Nightly share: 14 of 28 sites are 'Short Term Site' units for 1-30 nights at $25 a night; the other 14 are 'Long Term Site' units with monthly billing ('Payments on long term stays will be billed at the first of the month'). No wording discourages nightly guests; seasonal May-September only, so not year-round residents. Imagery shows a few rigs among tree-lined pull-through rows. Google 4.5 (35). Passes the long-stay tests on this reading (50% nightly).
PIN: stored 47.29434,-101.64180 is at the street corner at the park's east end; the site rows run west from it (middle about 47.2941,-101.6429, ~90 m). ok.
WEBSITE: both URLs answer 200; keep. PHONE 701-748-6948 confirmed (WebReserv and Google).
LEAD: none. WebReserv also lists the city's Antelope Creek RV Park (45 year-round pull-through sites, reservations by phone 701-880-8212); 'Antelope Creek RV Park' is already in campgrounds.json.
